summary.notice: SIMULATED fills placed by this repository's own code at the posted quote. No order was sent to Kalshi and this is NOT the demo account's performance; the account itself is reported separately in data/portfolio.json. Execution at the full posted size is assumed — the order book is not consulted.
summary.equity_definition: cash + mark-to-market value of open positions (derived from last_price_dollars)

fade_down_move.describe: Buy YES at the posted ask after a >= $0.10 drop in the collected tick history, while the price is still <= $0.45.
fade_down_move.verdict: 0 settled trades — too few to describe a pattern (threshold 10); nothing is claimed

ride_up_move.describe: Buy YES at the posted ask after a >= $0.10 rise with meaningful 24h volume, capped at $0.90.
ride_up_move.verdict: 0 settled trades — too few to describe a pattern (threshold 10); nothing is claimed

longshot_no_fade.describe: Buy NO at the posted ask where YES is quoted at $0.90 or better and the market closes within 7 days.
longshot_no_fade.verdict: 0 settled trades — too few to describe a pattern (threshold 10); nothing is claimed

converge_yes.describe: Buy YES at the posted ask on a near-certain, high-volume market closing within 3 days (harvest the last cents).
converge_yes.verdict: 0 settled trades — too few to describe a pattern (threshold 10); nothing is claimed

entry_rules_fired_but_no_order_this_run.meaning: a match with no order means the posted quote could not be taken at the simulated size; the desk never invents a fill price

policy.fee_model: 0.07 x series fee_multiplier x contracts x p x (1-p), rounded up
policy.fee_constant_source: Kalshi general fee schedule; the 0.07 constant is not restated on docs.kalshi.com — see pages/flagged.html
